Development sample • Confirm the scope and quantities before approval. Prices are sample selling prices, not supplier quotes.
Replace roofing on the identified structure using the selected HDZ system, underlayment, perimeter materials and agreed ventilation.

Site review: confirm access, decking condition, flashing, ventilation and disposal arrangements. Hidden damage and additional work require a separately approved change. Schedule and payment terms must be agreed before work starts.
Approval accepts the scope and price shown in this estimate. The material list supports fulfillment; changes to that list do not change this signed estimate.
Sample agreement for development testing. Replace sample terms with your organization’s approved terms before customer use.
